subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

P_RQPS_ _P_ _Q_SR_P_RQ
solution:
Given: P_RQPS_ _P_ _Q_SR_P_RQ

By checking options and substituting accordingly:

**1) SRQSRPQS → **P**S**RQ - PS**RQ **- P**SR**Q - **P**SR**Q - **P**S**RQ

 ♦ Here **"****PSRQ"** is repeated.

2) SRSQRPQS → P**S**RQ - PS**RS - **P**QR**Q - **P**SR**Q - **P**S**RQ

3) QRQSRPQS → P**Q**RQ - PS**RQ - **P**SR**Q - **P**SR**Q - **P**S**RQ

4) SQQSRPQS → P**S**RQ - PS**QQ - **P**SR**Q - **P**SR**Q - **P**S**RQ

 
• Option (1) gives a pattern of ***PSRQ*** - PSRQ - ***PSRQ*** - PSRQ - ***PSRQ***.

Hence, **SRQSRPQS **is the correct answer.
